name: gpt-researcher
description_en: An autonomous agent that conducts deep research on any data using any LLM providers
readme_excerpt: English | 中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Русский 🔎 GPT Researcher GPT Researcher the first open deep research agent designed for both web and local research on any given task. The agent produces detailed, factual, and unbiased research reports with citations. GPT Researcher provides a full suite of customization options to create tailor made and domain specific research agents. Inspired by the recent Plan-and-Solve and RAG papers, GPT Researcher addresses misinformation, speed, determinism, and reliability…
